title: Mode button
description: On and off switch for a screen mode, such as Maintenance Mode. Off, it is a round outlined icon button with a solid icon. On, it grows sideways into a primary Button with the label and a green dot, and a click turns it off again. Built from Icon button and Button.

props.x: Off is the round icon button, on is the labelled primary Button.
Green dot at the end of the label while active.
Fires from either state; the screen flips active.

values.v: Icon button 38px, variant outline, icon in fill weight
Button primary, height 38, right padding 44px to make room for the dot
10px circle #12b76a with a 2px white ring, 17px from the right edge
width .3s ease; the two layers cross-fade (.25s in, .15s out)

usedIn: School Screen, Maintenance Mode (Smart Boot, Pull Box, Tablet List and Smart Light tabs).
